# Uptime

Get the uptime of target hosts. `osapi behavior get --name uptime` and `osapi behavior method get` show the same.

## Method get

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Name | get |
| Verb | read |
| Description | Get the uptime of the host |
| Detail | Reads how long the host has run since it booted: /proc/uptime on Linux, and the boot time that sysctl gives on macOS. The uptime is in days, hours and minutes, and in seconds. |
| HTTP | GET |
| Route | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/uptime |
| Permission | uptime:read |
| Command | [osapi client node uptime get](../../../../usage/cli/client/node/uptime/get.md) |
| Input type | GetInput |
| Output type | Entry |

### Input (0)

None. The method takes no input; its command needs only --target.
